stories.title: One Ohio State football team could win it all -- just not the one you think
stories.summary: One football team in Columbus still has national title hopes. Just not the one with Jeremiah Smith.

stories.title: Reid offers Saints farewell: 'Things don't always go the way you planned'
stories.summary: The Saints have granted Justin Reid's request to be released, with the safety posting on social media: "In life and sports, things don't always go the way you planned or hoped they would."

stories.title: Ballon d'Or winner Kane out a 'few months' after ankle injury in Bayern draw
stories.summary: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane is set to be out for several months after suffering a ligament tear in his left ankle during Bayern Munich's draw with Cologne.

stories.title: Colts cut ties with QB Jones, turn to Richardson for next start
stories.summary: The Colts have cut quarterback Daniel Jones after a challenging 11-game stint in 2026 and are turning to Anthony Richardson Sr. to start going forward.

stories.title: Police investigating as man dies days after alleged incident at 49ers-Cowboys
stories.summary: Police are investigating the death of a man who was allegedly involved in an altercation before Sunday's game between the Cowboys and 49ers at AT&T Stadium.
